execution_contract.targeted_junit_multiset: exact V08 B union N; each once PASS
execution_contract.collection_multiset: parsed from raw collect stdout of same attempt/environment
execution_contract.full_junit_multiset: exact collection multiset; each once PASS; no skipped/error/deselected
execution_contract.full_required_intersection: exact V08 B union N; each once PASS
execution_contract.targeted_expansion: replace the single macro with 164 V08.behavior_required_nodes elements in stored order followed by 53 V08.evidence_negative_required_nodes elements in stored order; no sort, dedupe or filtering

identity_contract.observation_cardinality: exact one parent observation for every (suite,nodeid) in targeted/full x V08.B
identity_contract.scenario_nonce_uniqueness: 328 parent observations; each nonce attempt-global unique
identity_contract.checkpoint_id_uniqueness: 328 parent observations; each checkpoint_id attempt-global unique
identity_contract.raw_child_cardinality: for each parent, exact binding capture set x required resource instances x {before,after}
identity_contract.architect_input_copy_rule: byte-exact copy bound by published SHA; no generated identity fields may be injected

component_boundaries.producer_output: identity plus raw capture references/hashes only
component_boundaries.copy_equivalent_detection: same counterfactual corpus is run against reporter and verifier; every rule must independently reject with the same contract code while source modules share no project semantic imports

primary_error_policy: stop after first precedence class and emit exactly one primary error code

gate_formula.software_claim_ok: targeted_exact AND collection_exact AND full_suite_exact AND compileall_ok AND calendar_ok AND software_behavior_ok
gate_formula.evidence_payload_claim_ok: v08_manifest_ok AND v09_manifest_ok AND targeted_exact AND collection_exact AND full_suite_exact AND negative_semantics_ok AND counterfactual_semantics_ok AND identity_ok AND component_boundaries_ok AND mandatory_inputs_ok AND baseline_ok AND predecessor_failed_siblings_ok AND portability_ok AND preseal_ok AND truthful_reports_ok
gate_formula.any_false: no authoritative canonical run or final receipt; quarantine same attempt and exit nonzero

capture_envelope_schema.payload_relative_path_rule: normalized run-relative path; no absolute, traversal or symlink escape
capture_envelope_schema.payload_bytes_rule: actual raw bytes are stored separately and byte count must match
capture_envelope_schema.payload_sha256_rule: lowercase SHA-256 of actual raw bytes
capture_envelope_schema.resource_instance_id_rule: opaque registry token created when the concrete SUT handle is registered; identical before/after

algorithms.COUNT_SDK_PENDING_DELTA: parse both sdk_call_trace raw arrays; count after-only calls whose action equals the captured TRADE_ACTION_PENDING constant
algorithms.COUNT_SDK_REMOVE_DELTA: parse both sdk_call_trace raw arrays; count after-only calls whose action equals the captured TRADE_ACTION_REMOVE constant
algorithms.COUNT_RESTART_CALLBACK_DELTA: count StartOldMain plus StartOldWatchdog in rollback_policy after ordered_trace minus before
algorithms.EXTRACT_PUBLIC_VALIDATION_ERRORS: decode actual public CLI/function result from raw capture; preserve ordered exact error strings; independently corroborate nonzero/FAIL state
algorithms.DERIVE_AUTHORITATIVE_DOMAIN_STATE: apply the scenario's Talimat09 state precedence to raw SQLite, JSONL, broker, validator and filesystem records; raw state summary labels are forbidden
algorithms.COMPARE_CANONICAL_RESOURCE_SNAPSHOTS: compare canonical member/row/call values from before and after raw bytes; missing pointer is FAIL
algorithms.DERIVE_DOMAIN_OUTCOME: derive only after all other scenario assertions from raw have been evaluated; map the exact V09 literal for that satisfied branch; raw outcome labels are forbidden
algorithms.DERIVE_NAMED_DOMAIN_FACT: compute the named fact from the listed typed raw payloads using the exact scenario algorithm and literals in Talimat09/V09; the raw payload may not contain that fact name/value as a supplied projection

derivation_contract.counterfactual_rule: both clean evaluators emit their accessed scalar JSON-pointer set for the rule; sets must be equal and nonempty; choose its lexicographically first pointer, then boolean invert, integer +1, finite number +1, or string append '#cf' according to its exact schema type; update only that raw payload plus its envelope hashes, rerun the real evaluators, and require this rule_id to fail
derivation_contract.reference_algorithm: reporter and semantic verifier independently derive the right-side projection from the same immutable raw captures; neither may consume the other's projection or the report under test
derivation_contract.counterfactual_gate: mutate a listed source raw payload, recompute envelope hash/manifest as the case requires, and prove this one assertion becomes false with V09_SEMANTIC_CHECK_FAILED:<rule_id>

closed_operation_semantics.SET_LITERAL:x: replace the target with the exact UTF-8/JSON literal x
closed_operation_semantics.ADD_LITERAL:x: add exact literal x at the named absent pointer
closed_operation_semantics.APPEND_BASE64_UTF8:x: strict base64-decode x and append those exact UTF-8 bytes; the decoded value is mutation input only and must not be copied into clean/sealed evidence
closed_operation_semantics.SET_BASE64_UTF8:x: strict base64-decode x and set the target to that exact UTF-8 string; the decoded value is mutation input only and must not be copied into clean/sealed evidence
closed_operation_semantics.ADD_INTEGER:1: replace a required integer n with n+1
closed_operation_semantics.APPEND_EXACT_DUPLICATE: append one byte/JSON-identical copy of the selected existing item
closed_operation_semantics.DELETE: delete only the selected JSON/source member
closed_operation_semantics.DELETE_FILE: unlink only the exact normalized fixture-relative path
closed_operation_semantics.CREATE_NEW_SENTINEL: create the named path with exclusive create using fixed bytes V09-COLLISION
closed_operation_semantics.SET_ZERO_SHA256: set the target string to exactly 64 ASCII zeroes
closed_operation_semantics.TRUNCATE_LAST_BYTE: remove exactly the last byte from a nonempty candidate
closed_operation_semantics.COPY_SAME_SOURCE_FROM_DISTINCT_ATTEMPT: copy the same source/capture type from a clean fixture with a distinct fixed attempt_id foreign-attempt
closed_operation_semantics.all_other_registry_tokens: execute their literal token description exactly; no equivalent substitute or second mutation

baseline_contract.secret_rule: hash/path/byte-count only; never copy or seal contents
baseline_contract.nonsecret_rule: copy bytes create-new; record source and copy SHA; mark directory read-only after fsync
baseline_contract.mismatch_action: no source edit; BASELINE_HASH_MISMATCH; exit nonzero

v08_manifest_ok.recompute: SHA-256 equals d58ec29ba93cdbc88a9978e1860bf8ae5eaf8fa5913778a6de1b5d1ff2c3fbdf and closed counts/edges exact

v09_manifest_ok.recompute: byte SHA-256 equals architect-published Talimat09 value and all closed schemas/bindings validate

targeted_exact.recompute: JUnit multiset exact V08 B then N selection; each once PASS

collection_exact.recompute: raw collect stdout parsed with exact execution contract and no deselection

full_suite_exact.recompute: JUnit multiset exact collection multiset; each once PASS

compileall_ok.recompute: compileall subprocess exact argv/source set and exit 0

calendar_ok.recompute: C01 bindings and independent source hashes exact

software_behavior_ok.recompute: all non-M01/M02/M03 V09 B bindings pass in targeted and full

continuation_behavior_ok.recompute: all M01/M02/M03 V09 B bindings pass in targeted and full

negative_semantics_ok.recompute: all 53 N clean/mutated public subprocess contracts exact

counterfactual_semantics_ok.recompute: every behavior assertion rule has a raw counterfactual and fails exact rule id

component_boundaries_ok.recompute: AST and runtime import/dataflow contract exact

mandatory_inputs_ok.recompute: all mandatory path/bytes/SHA exact including V08/V09 and real configs hash-only

baseline_ok.recompute: baseline_contract exact and before-FAIL/after-PASS regression exact

predecessor_failed_siblings_ok.recompute: run-017/run-016 and eight named failed siblings before/after count/tree SHA exact

portability_ok.recompute: full tree text/binary allowlist and path scan exact

preseal_ok.recompute: actual candidate members excluding preseal/manifest exact

truthful_reports_ok.recompute: all report fields equal independently recomputed leaves/formulas

prepublish_verifier_ok.recompute: decoded prepublish stdout schema/exit/source SHA exact

final_semantic_verifier_ok.recompute: decoded final stdout schema/exit/source SHA exact

receipt_verifier_ok.recompute: invoke the read-only receipt verifier against the final receipt and canonical run; exit 0 and decoded stdout schema/source SHA exact; this stdout is not embedded in the receipt

delivery_integrity_ok.recompute: canonical manifest 1:1 path/bytes/SHA and tree SHA exact

publication_contract_ok.recompute: all publication_contract transitions, exclusive reservations, no-overwrite operations, fsyncs and final namespace facts exact

publication_contract.run_id_selection: first numeric run id whose canonical, temp, receipt, failed-run and failed-receipt namespaces are all absent
sequence: write/fsync preseal over every candidate member except preseal and manifest
write/fsync manifest as final member with create-new
atomic no-overwrite rename temp to canonical
atomic no-overwrite rename receipt candidate to final receipt
publication_contract.final_failure: atomic no-overwrite rename canonical to run-NNN.failed-<attempt_id>; no final receipt; nonzero
publication_contract.receipt_failure: preserve receipt as .failed-receipt-<attempt_id>; quarantine canonical as run-NNN.failed-<attempt_id>; nonzero
publication_contract.collision: leave all preexisting bytes unchanged; quarantine current attempt; nonzero
publication_contract.authority_moment: only after final receipt no-overwrite rename and parent fsync
publication_contract.noncircular_authority_rule: canonical JSON and receipt-candidate must keep authoritative=false; after final receipt rename+parent fsync, authoritative is an externally recomputed fact from gate_formula and current filesystem, never a field written back into either sealed object
publication_contract.receipt_self_verification_forbidden: receipt contains prepublish/final stdout bytes and source hashes but never receipt-verifier stdout/hash-of-itself

immutable_history_contract.before_after_rule: each named tree's relative member count and canonical tree SHA-256 must exist before and after and be byte-exact equal

delivery_contract.manifest_rule: every final member except output-manifest.json appears exactly once with normalized relative path, bytes and SHA-256; no undeclared member
